questions.solution_text:
$y=2^{x}$ is an exponential growth curve, so it is concave up on $0\le x\le 3$.
Every chord joining two points of a concave-up curve lies above the curve.
Each trapezium therefore includes extra area, so the estimate is greater than the exact value.

questions.solution_text:
$y=6x-x^{2}$
$y'=6-2x$
$y''=-2$
$y''<0$, so the curve is concave down on $1\le x\le 5$.
Every chord lies below the curve, so the estimate is less than the exact value.
